Intel: chunk multi-function Rust source into pieces

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"chunk_max_size\":30,\"language\":\"rust\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("fn alpha() {}\n\nfn beta() {}\n\nfn gamma() {}\n\nfn delta() {}\n", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.metrics().totalLines());
        System.out.println(result.chunks());
    }
}
```
